phenomenon: A true-colour orbital view of the southern Great Barrier Reef and central Queensland coast
colour_harmony_note: The reef's natural aqua channels, deep-teal ocean and neutral Queensland coastline align directly with the DTL palette; the image has not been recoloured, generated or synthetically altered.
caption: From orbit, the southern Great Barrier Reef resolves into a vast maze of coral cays and channels along Queensland's coast.
verification_note: NASA Earth Observatory identifies this as a nadir true-colour MISR image acquired on 26 August 2000 and showing the southern Great Barrier Reef beside central Queensland. Wikimedia Commons preserves the original and records its NASA public-domain status.
attribution_text: Image: NASA/GSFC/LaRC/JPL, MISR Team / Wikimedia Commons (Public Domain)
